incidents.title: checkout-api 504s during evening peak
incidents.summary: Checkout requests timed out for 38 minutes. HikariCP pool was exhausted; connections were being held by a slow analytics query on the shared primary.
incidents.error_signature: HikariPool-1 - Connection is not available, request timed out after Nms

resolution.action: Raised HikariCP maximumPoolSize 10 -> 30 and moved the analytics query to the read replica.

incidents.title: All external traffic failing TLS handshake
incidents.summary: Every external request failed the TLS handshake for 47 minutes. The wildcard certificate expired; the cert-manager renewal had been failing silently for three weeks.
incidents.error_signature: x509: certificate has expired or is not yet valid

resolution.action: Manually renewed the certificate; added alerts on cert-manager Certificate NotReady and on any cert expiring within 14 days.

incidents.title: notification-worker OOMKilled every few hours
incidents.summary: Celery workers were OOMKilled roughly every six hours. The default prefetch pulled thousands of queued messages into each worker's memory at once.
incidents.error_signature: OOMKilled: container exceeded memory limit

resolution.action: Set worker_prefetch_multiplier=1 and max_tasks_per_child=500.

incidents.title: Order creation failing with 500s
incidents.summary: Order creation returned 500s for 52 minutes. A new reporting endpoint held database connections open inside a long transaction and exhausted the HikariCP pool.
incidents.error_signature: HikariPool-1 - Connection is not available, request timed out after Nms

resolution.action: Ran the report query in a read-only transaction with a 5s statement timeout; enabled leakDetectionThreshold=10000.

incidents.title: Login failures after Redis restart
incidents.summary: Logins failed for 14 minutes after a Redis restart. Every session lookup missed the cache at once and the resulting stampede overloaded the identity database.
incidents.error_signature: LOADING Redis is loading the dataset in memory

resolution.action: Added request coalescing on cache miss so concurrent lookups for one key share a single DB query; added jitter to TTLs.

incidents.title: order-events consumer lag reached 2M
incidents.summary: Consumer lag on order-events grew to two million messages. A slow downstream call inside the poll loop exceeded max.poll.interval.ms, so the group rebalanced continuously and made no progress.
incidents.error_signature: CommitFailedException: Commit cannot be completed since the group has already rebalanced

resolution.action: Moved the downstream call off the poll thread; raised max.poll.interval.ms to 600000.

incidents.title: Search returning empty results after deploy
incidents.summary: Search returned no results for 18 minutes after a deploy. The release changed the configured index alias to one that did not exist.
incidents.error_signature: index_not_found_exception

resolution.action: Rolled back; added a startup check that fails the pod if the configured index alias does not exist.

incidents.title: Card processor calls failing certificate validation
incidents.summary: All outbound calls to the card processor failed for 63 minutes. The processor rotated its intermediate CA and our pinned CA bundle was stale.
incidents.error_signature: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority

resolution.action: Updated the CA bundle; replaced certificate pinning with the system trust store plus the processor's published bundle.

incidents.title: search-api pods restarting under load
incidents.summary: search-api pods restarted repeatedly during peak traffic. An unbounded in-process LRU of query results grew past the 2Gi memory limit.
incidents.error_signature: OOMKilled: container exceeded memory limit

resolution.action: Capped the LRU at 10k entries and moved the result cache to Redis.

incidents.title: Notifications delayed by 40 minutes
incidents.summary: Notifications were delayed by up to 40 minutes. Messages were keyed by tenant id, so one large tenant's partition carried 70% of all traffic while other consumers sat idle.
incidents.error_signature: Consumer group lag exceeded threshold

resolution.action: Re-keyed messages on tenant id plus user id and increased partitions from 12 to 48.

incidents.title: Stock reservation latency spike
incidents.summary: Stock reservation p99 latency rose to 8 seconds. A node drain halved the pod count, and the remaining pods' 10-connection HikariCP pools saturated.
incidents.error_signature: HikariPool-1 - Connection is not available, request timed out after Nms

resolution.action: Restored the replica count; set HPA minReplicas=4 so a drain cannot drop capacity that far.

incidents.title: Flash-sale SKU hot key saturates Redis
incidents.summary: During a flash sale a single SKU's key took 40% of Redis CPU and stock reads timed out across the service.
incidents.error_signature: RedisCommandTimeoutException: Command timed out after Nms

resolution.action: Added a 1-second in-process cache in front of Redis for hot SKUs.

incidents.title: Tax engine feature flag rolled to 100%
incidents.summary: The new tax engine flag was set to 100% instead of 5%. Tax calculation failed for about 30% of orders, in regions the new engine did not yet support.
incidents.error_signature: TaxCalculationException: no rate for region

resolution.action: Rolled the flag back to 0%; flag changes above 10% now need a second approver.

incidents.title: Rebalance storm during rolling deploy
incidents.summary: Each pod restart during a rolling deploy triggered a full consumer group rebalance, pausing all order-event processing for most of the 25-minute rollout.
incidents.error_signature: CommitFailedException: Commit cannot be completed since the group has already rebalanced

resolution.action: Switched to the cooperative-sticky assignor and enabled static group membership.

incidents.title: Internal mTLS broken by expired CA
incidents.summary: mTLS between the gateway and internal services failed after the internal CA certificate expired over the holiday break.
incidents.error_signature: x509: certificate has expired or is not yet valid

resolution.action: Reissued the internal CA with a two-year validity and added an expiry dashboard covering every CA.

incidents.title: Email render tasks leaking memory
incidents.summary: Email rendering tasks leaked memory until workers were OOMKilled. A template cache was keyed on user id instead of template id, so it grew with every recipient.
incidents.error_signature: OOMKilled: container exceeded memory limit

resolution.action: Keyed the template cache on template id; set max_tasks_per_child=200 as a backstop.

incidents.title: Mass session expiry at midnight
incidents.summary: A bulk forced re-login issued every session with the same fixed TTL. They all expired together at midnight and the re-auth stampede exhausted identity database connections.
incidents.error_signature: identity-db: too many connections

resolution.action: Added plus or minus 10% jitter to session TTLs.

incidents.title: All tokens rejected after deploy
incidents.summary: A deploy shipped with JWT_ISSUER unset. Every token failed issuer validation and all authenticated requests were rejected for 16 minutes.
incidents.error_signature: JsonWebTokenError: jwt issuer invalid

resolution.action: Rolled back; made JWT_ISSUER required at boot so the service crashes instead of running with an empty value.

incidents.title: Checkout outage after Postgres failover
incidents.summary: Checkout was fully down for 21 minutes after a Postgres failover. HikariCP kept handing out dead connections to the old primary, and every request waited out the full connection timeout.
incidents.error_signature: Connection marked as broken because of SQLSTATE(08006)

resolution.action: Lowered maxLifetime to 5 minutes and enabled keepaliveTime so dead connections are evicted quickly after a failover.

incidents.title: Poison message blocks notification consumer
incidents.summary: A malformed message crashed the consumer on every attempt. The offset never advanced, so the whole partition stalled behind it.
incidents.error_signature: JSONDecodeError: Expecting value: line 1 column 1

resolution.action: Added a dead-letter topic; messages that fail three times are moved there and the consumer continues.

incidents.title: Orders API routed to wrong backend
incidents.summary: A typo in a route config change sent /v2/orders traffic to the inventory backend, which returned 404 for 25 minutes.
incidents.error_signature: upstream returned 404 for route

resolution.action: Rolled back; added route contract tests to CI that assert each path reaches its intended backend.

incidents.title: Webhook callbacks rejected after cert renewal
incidents.summary: After a certificate renewal the webhook endpoint served the leaf certificate without its intermediate chain, and the processor rejected every callback.
incidents.error_signature: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority

resolution.action: Stored the full chain in the TLS secret; added a certificate chain check to the deploy pipeline.

incidents.title: Shared config change shrank inventory pool
incidents.summary: A release picked up a change to the shared config defaults that lowered HikariCP maximumPoolSize to 5, and inventory-service ran out of connections at normal load.
incidents.error_signature: HikariPool-1 - Connection is not available, request timed out after Nms

resolution.action: Restored the pool size; each service now sets its pool size explicitly rather than inheriting the shared default.

incidents.title: Nightly import starves order API
incidents.summary: The nightly import job and the order API shared one HikariCP pool. The import took every connection and API requests timed out for 44 minutes.
incidents.error_signature: HikariPool-1 - Connection is not available, request timed out after Nms

resolution.action: Gave the import job its own pool capped at 5 connections, separate from the API pool.

incidents.title: Large aggregations exhaust search-api memory
incidents.summary: Large aggregation queries loaded entire Elasticsearch responses into memory and pods were OOMKilled.
incidents.error_signature: OOMKilled: container exceeded memory limit

resolution.action: Switched to search_after pagination with 500-document pages.

incidents.title: Carts lost to Redis eviction
incidents.summary: Under memory pressure, Redis evicted cart keys under its allkeys-lru policy and customers reached checkout with empty carts.
incidents.error_signature: cart not found for session

resolution.action: Moved carts to a dedicated Redis with the noeviction policy and double the memory.

incidents.title: Reprocessing after partition increase
incidents.summary: After partitions were added to order-events, consumers had auto.offset.reset=earliest and reprocessed the new partitions from the beginning, building a large lag.
incidents.error_signature: Consumer group lag exceeded threshold

resolution.action: Set auto.offset.reset=latest and added idempotency keys so reprocessing is harmless.
